Additionally, Binance stated that user funds remain safe due to its Secure Asset Fund for Users.

To support budding talents, he established the Indian Super Gaming League. Through LetsGameNow, he envisions a thriving gaming ecosystem that blends entertainment, commerce, and community, ultimately cultivating a robust foundation for aspiring esports champions on a global scale.
